question: What are the best alternatives to the Baseus 100W USB-C cable?
query: best alternatives to Baseus 100W USB-C cable Anker UGREEN Belkin Cable Matters reviews specifications 2026

replays.text:
The best alternative depends on whether you need charging only or also fast data and monitor support:

- **Best like-for-like for charging: UGREEN Nexode Retractable USB-C Cable 100W.** It matches the 100W rating and retracts for easier storage. The tradeoff: it’s not suitable for monitor connections and has slow data transfer. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html))
- **Best if you need data and video too: Cable Matters 10Gbps USB-C to USB-C Cable.** It supports 100W charging, 10Gbps transfers, and a 4K monitor, making it the more versatile pick. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html))
- **Best upgrade: Anker 515 USB-C Cable (USB4).** It supports up to 240W, 20Gbps data, and 8K monitor support—more capability than most people need for a basic charging cable. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html))

**My pick:** Cable Matters for an all-round replacement; UGREEN if you mainly charge and want a retractable cable. Check the exact listing for the length and features you need.

Good alternatives depend on whether you need charging only or also fast data and video:

- **Best like-for-like pick: [Cable Matters 10Gbps USB-C to USB-C cable](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html)** — supports **100W charging**, **10Gbps data**, and **4K monitor output**, so it’s the most versatile 100W alternative in the results.
- **Best if you want a retractable cable: [UGREEN Nexode Retractable 100W](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html)** — handy and tangle-free, but it’s **not suitable for monitors** and has slower data transfer.
- **Best for extra performance: [Anker 515 USB-C cable](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html)** — rated for **240W**, **20Gbps**, and **8K monitor support**. Choose it if you want more than basic 100W charging.

For a laptop cable that may also connect to a monitor or dock, I’d pick the **Cable Matters**. For charging only, the **UGREEN** is a convenient option.

Good alternatives depend on whether you need just charging or also fast data and video:

- **Best like-for-like: [Cable Matters 10Gbps USB-C cable](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html)** — supports **100W charging**, **10Gbps data**, and **4K monitor output**, making it the strongest all-round replacement if you use a laptop, dock, or monitor.
- **Best if you want a retractable cable: [UGREEN Nexode Retractable 100W](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html)** — offers 100W charging in a tangle-free design. Trade-off: it’s not a good choice for monitors or fast file transfers.
- **Best if you want more headroom: [Anker USB4 Gen 2 cable](https://www.itechguides.com/best-usb-c-cables-2026-expert-reviews-and-buying-advice/)** — rated up to **240W**, **20Gbps**, and 4K/60Hz video. A good pick if you may upgrade devices, though it’s more cable than you need for basic 100W charging.

**My pick:** Cable Matters for the closest all-purpose substitute; UGREEN if portability and neat storage matter most. Check the exact model’s specs before buying—USB-C cables with similar names can have very different data and video capabilities.
